fields.title: Enable file output for body
fields.description: Whether to use a default body file when no actual request is available. If enabled, the file selected below is used as the body. If disabled, an empty body is returned.

fields.title: File for response body
fields.description: File chooser for selecting a file containing the body. This default body is returned while building the workflow when no actual request is available.

fields.title: Default headers
fields.description: The default headers to return while building the workflow when no actual request is available.

fields.title: Default query parameters
fields.description: The default query parameters to return while building the workflow when no actual request is available.
